stories.title: Jesús de Miguel
stories.about: Jesús de Miguel Alameda was a Spanish professional footballer who played as a striker.
stories.headline: On 2 November 2026, de Miguel suffered a blunt cardiac injury in a collision with FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono which caused him to go into cardiac arrest.

stories.title: Gina Hinojosa
stories.about: Regina Inez Hinojosa is an American politician and lawyer who is the governor-elect of Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, she has represented the 49th district in the Texas House of Representatives since 2017.
stories.headline: A member of the Democratic Party, she has represented the 49th district in the Texas House of Representatives since 2017.

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed
stories.about: Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed, is an American epidemiologist, academic, and politician who is the United States senator-elect from the state of Michigan.
stories.headline: On November 2, 2026, American singer Bruce Springsteen announced his support for El-Sayed, calling him a fighter in defense of the U.S. Constitution and democracy against corrupt, anti-American leadership.

stories.title: 2026 United States elections
stories.about: Elections were held in the United States on November 3, 2026, during the second term of Republican president Donald Trump. All 435 seats in the U.S. House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 seats in the U.S. Senate were contested to determine the 120th United States Congress. Thirty-nine state and territorial U.S. gubernatorial elections, attorney general elections, and numerous state and local elections were also contested. The Democratic Party has won a majority of seats in both houses of Congress, and won numerous other offices currently held by Republicans.
stories.headline: Elections were held in the United States on November 3, 2026, during the second term of Republican president Donald Trump.

stories.title: 2028 United States Senate elections
stories.summary: Senate election for the 121st US Congress
stories.about: The 2028 United States Senate elections will be held on November 7, 2028, with 34 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested in regular elections, the winners of which will serve 6-year terms in the United States Congress from January 3, 2029, to January 3, 2035, which will include the entire term of the president who wins the 2028 presidential election and the first two years of the 2032 presidential election winner's term. Senators are divided into three classes whose terms are staggered so that a different class is elected every other year. Class 3 senators were last elected in 2022, and will be up for election again in 2028. A special election is expected to be held in Tennessee, to fill Marsha Blackburn's unexpired Senate term. These elections will run concurrently with the 2028 United States presidential election. Democrats are defending five seats in states that voted for Donald Trump in 2024.
stories.headline: A special election is expected to be held in Tennessee, to fill Marsha Blackburn's unexpired Senate term.

stories.title: VisionQuest
stories.about: VisionQuest is an American television miniseries created by Terry Matalas for the streaming service Disney+, based on Marvel Comics featuring the character Vision. A spin-off from and sequel to the miniseries WandaVision (2021), it is the 18th television series in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) from Marvel Studios and is produced under its Marvel Television label. The series shares continuity with the films of the MCU. It follows the synthezoid Vision as he attempts to understand who he is by communicating with AI personas embedded in his programming, and goes on the run with a mysterious teenager who may be his reincarnated son. Matalas serves as showrunner and a director.
stories.headline: In October 2026, Mollica announced that Joe Locke would reprise his MCU role of Billy Maximoff from Agatha All Along in VisionQuest.

stories.title: .xyz
stories.about: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program. Its name consists of the last three letters of the Latin-script alphabet. XYZ.com and CentralNic are the registries for the domain, which was created by entrepreneur Daniel Negari. It became available to the general public on June 2, 2014, thereafter becoming widely used by tech startups, creators, and Web3 projects.
stories.headline: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program.

stories.title: Philippine authorities seize a shipment of methamphetamine
stories.summary: Philippine authorities seize a shipment of methamphetamine, whose origin is traced to Laos, at the Manila International Container Port. The shipment had arrived six days after local police in Laos found the similar contraband, supposed to be brought to the Philippines, on October 1.

stories.title: The Bangladeshi garment industry wage board agrees to increase minimum wages…
stories.summary: The Bangladeshi garment industry wage board agrees to increase minimum wages following five days of worker protests and clashes with police. Workers demand ৳30,000 (US$240) monthly, up from ৳12,500 (US$100), while the board has not specified the increase.

stories.title: The Singaporean parliament amends the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act of 2014
stories.summary: The Singaporean parliament amends the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act of 2014, introducing arrest powers, permitting trials without defendants present, and increasing maximum fines tenfold to S$20 million (US$15 million) following widespread air pollution from Indonesian wildfires.

stories.title: Hungary makes Communist-era secret police records publicly accessible through…
stories.summary: Hungary makes Communist-era secret police records publicly accessible through a database containing approximately 60,000 names linked to former state security services. Prime Minister Péter Magyar announces that additional documents will become available in February 2027.

stories.title: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory
stories.summary: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, a space telescope for studying gamma-ray bursts, re-enters Earth's atmosphere over Sumatra, ending its mission of nearly 22 years.
